properties.description: Verifies that reflow2-core's test consolidation from 225 files into 4 programs lost no tests. 1909 integration tests before = 1909 after (plus 3 guard tests). Guard test every_test_file_runs_in_exactly_one_program.rs reads Cargo.toml's [[test]] targets and fails if a file in tests/ is missing from all programs, appears in two programs, or if a declared module has no file.
properties.findings: 1909 integration tests before = 1909 after (plus 3 guard tests). Guard test every_test_file_runs_in_exactly_one_program.rs reads Cargo.toml's [[test]] targets and fails if a file in tests/ is missing from all programs.
properties.name: No test lost in core consolidation
